data.one_liner: Provides Kotlin-familiar scope functions like let, run, and also for Dart.
data.what_it_does: It implements Kotlin-like scope functions (let, run, also) as static extension methods in Dart. These functions help structure code blocks around objects, particularly handling null values and executing concise conditional expressions.
use_when: You want to use Kotlin-style scope functions such as let, also, and run in your Dart projects.
You need to execute code blocks conditionally on non-null values with clean syntax.
avoid_when: You prefer standard Dart control flow and null-aware operators without extension-based scope functions.
You require a large suite of Kotlin standard library utilities beyond let, run, and also.
strengths: Brings familiar Kotlin scoping constructs to Dart.
weaknesses: Very limited feature set consisting only of let, run, and also.
Not widely recognized or standard in the Dart ecosystem.
